hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | tr '\134' '/' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.py|src/*.py) OUT=$(ruff check "$f" 2>&1); CODE=$?; if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then REASON=$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"decision":"block","reason":%s,"continueOnBlock":true}' "$REASON"; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | tr '\134' '/' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) npx prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1; true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | tr '\134' '/' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.env|*.env.*|*/credentials/*|credentials/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: .env and credentials/ files must not be edited via Edit/Write"}}' ;; esac; }

b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" = "main" ] || [ "$b" = "master" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: on %s branch, create a feature branch first"}}' "$b"; fi
